value.title: Our New Rival Is Noodles
value.synopsis: Love Rice started a rice riot at the Harvest Festival and became a sensation overnight. They've been super busy with TV appearances, rice planting, and other activities, but the group's leader, Hinohikari, is acting strange... Meanwhile, a new exchange student arrives at Inaho Academy, and he's a ramen HarveStar named Sho. The members of Love Rice can't help feeling flustered by the appearance of a new rival. What will come of the peace that had settled between the grains?

value.title: Based on the Original Concept, Love Rice Is Really Meant to Be Aimed at Girls
value.synopsis: Hinohikari had suddenly collapsed in the classroom, worrying the other members of Love Rice. Then, after school, the door bursts open, and a new first-year named Oidemai suddenly puts on a Harvest Show. How will this passionate fan of Love Rice fit into the story? Meanwhile Yeast King, the bread HarveStar unit, is eating out with Love Rice when the waitress asks if they'd prefer bread or rice with their meals. And glaring through the window at their conversation from outside is Sho...

value.title: School HarveStar Love Rice
value.synopsis: Morinokuma-san and Koro-nee are getting married. The usual gang is in the audience at the reception, but Hinohikari is nowhere to be found. A comment from Morinokuma-san's students and a Harvest Show by Koshihikari bring the celebration to joyful new heights, until Morinokuma-san gets a phone call...

value.title: The Legendary Six Rice Boys (Mixed Rice)
Riceside Shakedown: The Movie
value.synopsis: Love Rice is in a celebratory mood after their victory in the Duel and the return of Hinohikari. Then Koshihikari arrives, and he seems troubled. It turns out he's decided to make a movie starring Sasanishiki! Hinohikari, Hitomebore, Akitakomachi, and Nikomaru are all on board, but Sasanishiki is less thrilled. Will they be able to complete the filming?

value.title: The Fake Sho Is Really a Carbohydrate-Free Diet
